name: 0001_core.sql
statements: PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS api_tokens (hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS snapshots (id TEXT NOT NULL, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, object_key TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant,id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reviews (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, submission_key TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, report_key TEXT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, cancelled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, token_limit INTEGER NOT NULL, tokens_used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, tokens_reserved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, deadline INTEGER NOT NULL, error TEXT)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS reviews_tenant ON reviews(tenant,created_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jobs (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, review_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reviews(id), attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, payload_key TEXT NOT NULL, result_key TEXT, lease_until INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS jobs_ready ON jobs(status,lease_until)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events (seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, review_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reviews(id), event TEXT NOT NULL, data TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS events_review ON events(review_id,seq)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS usage (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, review_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reviews(id), actor TEXT NOT NULL, phase TEXT NOT NULL, reserved INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, input_tokens INTEGER, output_tokens INTEGER, cost_usd REAL, model TEXT)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hypotheses (review_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reviews(id), id TEXT NOT NULL, object_key TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(review_id,id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS votes (review_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reviews(id), hypothesis_id TEXT NOT NULL, voter INTEGER NOT NULL, object_key TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(review_id,hypothesis_id,voter))

name: 0002_convergence.sql
statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lineages (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, repository TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('pr','branch')), ref TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(generation >= 1), round INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(round >= 0), previous_head TEXT, previous_review TEXT, posted_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', rounds_to_pass INTEGER, intent TEXT, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(tenant,repository,kind,ref))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lineage_reviews (seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, review_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, lineage_id TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL, snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL, round INTEGER, reviewed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, posted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS lineage_reviews_generation ON lineage_reviews(lineage_id,generation,seq)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS findings (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, lineage_id TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL, identity TEXT NOT NULL, review_id TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL, repository TEXT NOT NULL, rule_id TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL, source_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(source_kind IN ('agent','tool')), state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('new','worsened','pre-existing','fixed','unclassified')), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('open','fixed','dismissed')), round INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(round >= 1), first_posted_in TEXT, author_response_json TEXT, resolution_json TEXT, location_json TEXT NOT NULL, finding_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(tenant,lineage_id,generation,identity))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS findings_identity ON findings(tenant,identity,updated_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS findings_repository ON findings(tenant,repository)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS feedback (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, finding_id TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL, actor TEXT, note TEXT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
UPDATE feedback SET reason = CASE reason WHEN 'false_positive' THEN 'wrong' WHEN 'known' THEN 'intentional' ELSE reason END WHERE reason IN ('false_positive','known')
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS feedback_next

CREATE TABLE feedback_next (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, finding_id TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(reason IN ('fixed','wrong','intentional','irrelevant','style')), actor TEXT, note TEXT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO feedback_next(id,tenant,finding_id,reason,actor,note,created_at) SELECT id,tenant,finding_id,reason,actor,note,created_at FROM feedback
DROP TABLE feedback
ALTER TABLE feedback_next RENAME TO feedback
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS feedback_finding ON feedback(tenant,finding_id)

name: 0003_snapshot_contents.sql
statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS contents (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, hash TEXT NOT NULL, pack TEXT NOT NULL, offset INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(offset >= 0), size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(size >= 0), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(tenant,hash))

name: 0004_pr_mode.sql
statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS installations (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, account TEXT NOT NULL, repositories_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', suspended INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(suspended IN (0,1)), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS installations_tenant ON installations(tenant,account)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS deliveries (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, event TEXT NOT NULL, installation_id INTEGER, received_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS deliveries_received ON deliveries(received_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS publications (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, lineage_id TEXT NOT NULL, identity TEXT NOT NULL, review_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('finding','summary','check_run')), state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('posted','edited','resolved','failed')), external_id TEXT, thread_id TEXT, error TEXT, attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(attempts >= 1), updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(tenant,lineage_id,kind,identity))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS publications_review ON publications(tenant,review_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS finding_history (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, repository TEXT NOT NULL, identity TEXT NOT NULL, rule_id TEXT NOT NULL, first_seen_review TEXT NOT NULL, last_seen_review TEXT NOT NULL, seen_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(seen_count >= 1), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('open','fixed','dismissed')), author_response_json TEXT, dismissed_in TEXT, location_json TEXT NOT NULL, code_hash TEXT, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(tenant,repository,identity))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS finding_history_rule ON finding_history(tenant,repository,rule_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS finding_history_status ON finding_history(tenant,repository,status,updated_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS suppressions (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, repository TEXT NOT NULL, origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(origin IN ('proposed')), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('proposed','applied','declined')), entry_json TEXT NOT NULL, evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL, evidence_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(evidence_count >= 1), note TEXT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, decided_at INTEGER, UNIQUE(tenant,repository,entry_json))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS suppressions_status ON suppressions(tenant,repository,status)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS agent_cache (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, hunk_hash TEXT NOT NULL, context_hash TEXT NOT NULL, object_key TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, last_hit INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(tenant,hunk_hash,context_hash))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS agent_cache_retention ON agent_cache(tenant,created_at)

name: 0006_pull_requests.sql
statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pull_requests (review_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES reviews(id), tenant TEXT NOT NULL, installation_id INTEGER NOT NULL, repository TEXT NOT NULL, number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(number >= 1), request_key TEXT NOT NULL, trigger TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(trigger IN ('webhook','cli','command')), base_sha TEXT, head_sha TEXT, fork INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(fork IN (0,1)), author_login TEXT, author_type TEXT CHECK(author_type IS NULL OR author_type IN ('user','bot')), agent_json TEXT, consent INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(consent IN (0,1)), escalated INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(escalated IN (0,1)), reset INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(reset IN (0,1)), prepare_token_hash TEXT, claim TEXT, claimed_until INTEGER, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('requested','preparing','submitted','not_prepared','failed')), reason TEXT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(tenant,repository,number,request_key))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS pull_requests_prepare ON pull_requests(prepare_token_hash)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS pull_requests_number ON pull_requests(tenant,repository,number,created_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS publication_leases (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, lineage_id TEXT NOT NULL, holder TEXT NOT NULL, until INTEGER NOT NULL, published_seq INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY(tenant,lineage_id))
ALTER TABLE publications ADD COLUMN body_hash TEXT
ALTER TABLE publications ADD COLUMN url TEXT

name: 0007_council.sql
statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS council_assessments (review_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reviews(id), tenant TEXT NOT NULL, finding_id TEXT NOT NULL, member TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(member IN ('skeptic','exploit-author','code-owner','maintainer','tester')), round INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(round IN (1,2)), assessment_key TEXT, abstained INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(abstained IN (0,1)), cause TEXT CHECK(cause IS NULL OR cause IN ('invalid','no_evidence_refs','timeout','vendor_error','budget')), vendor TEXT, model TEXT NOT NULL, pack_hash TEXT NOT NULL, pack_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(pack_bytes >= 0), rendering_hash TEXT NOT NULL, rendering_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(rendering_bytes >= 0), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, expired INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(expired IN (0,1)), PRIMARY KEY(review_id,finding_id,member,round), CHECK(abstained = 1 OR cause IS NULL))

name: 0009_qa_seeds.sql
statements:
-- Versioned physical objects let pruning delete an old upload without racing a
-- concurrent writer of the same content hash. Heads are the only commit point.
CREATE TABLE qa_seed_parts (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, hash TEXT NOT NULL, object_key TEXT NOT NULL, bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(bytes >= 0), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(tenant,hash))
CREATE TABLE qa_seed_leases (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, max_size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(max_size > 0), expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(tenant,id))
CREATE INDEX qa_seed_lease_fingerprint ON qa_seed_leases(tenant,fingerprint,expires_at)

CREATE TABLE qa_seed_lease_parts (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, lease_id TEXT NOT NULL, hash TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(tenant,lease_id,hash), FOREIGN KEY(tenant,lease_id) REFERENCES qa_seed_leases(tenant,id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE qa_seed_versions (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, object_key TEXT NOT NULL, lease_id TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(tenant,id))
CREATE INDEX qa_seed_version_fingerprint ON qa_seed_versions(tenant,fingerprint)

CREATE TABLE qa_seed_version_parts (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, version_id TEXT NOT NULL, hash TEXT NOT NULL, object_key TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(tenant,version_id,hash), FOREIGN KEY(tenant,version_id) REFERENCES qa_seed_versions(tenant,id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE qa_seed_heads (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, version_id TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, valid INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY(tenant,fingerprint), FOREIGN KEY(tenant,version_id) REFERENCES qa_seed_versions(tenant,id))
CREATE TABLE qa_seed_garbage (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, object_key TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(tenant,object_key))
CREATE INDEX qa_seed_part_object ON qa_seed_parts(tenant,object_key)
CREATE INDEX qa_seed_pending_part ON qa_seed_lease_parts(tenant,hash,lease_id)
CREATE INDEX qa_seed_version_part_hash ON qa_seed_version_parts(tenant,hash)
CREATE INDEX qa_seed_version_part_object ON qa_seed_version_parts(tenant,object_key)

name: 0010_qa_runs.sql
statements: CREATE TABLE qa_runs (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, review_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES reviews(id), job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs(id), attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, step_id TEXT NOT NULL, version TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(version IN ('base','head')), state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('pending','running','complete','partial','cancelled','failed')), backend TEXT NOT NULL, model TEXT NOT NULL, deadline INTEGER NOT NULL, cell_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, cell_wall_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, evidence_limit INTEGER NOT NULL, evidence_used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, seed_max_size INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2147483648, configuration TEXT, generation TEXT, token_hash TEXT, control_hash TEXT, control_expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, result_key TEXT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE(job_id,attempt))
CREATE INDEX qa_runs_review_step ON qa_runs(review_id,step_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX qa_runs_capability ON qa_runs(token_hash) WHERE token_hash IS NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE qa_cells (run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES qa_runs(id), id TEXT NOT NULL, descriptor TEXT NOT NULL, tokens_used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, tokens_reserved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, exhausted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY(run_id,id))

CREATE TABLE qa_model_usage (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES qa_runs(id), cell_id TEXT NOT NULL, generation TEXT NOT NULL, reserved INTEGER NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('reserved','completed','failed')), input_tokens INTEGER, output_tokens INTEGER, charged_tokens INTEGER, estimated INTEGER, cost_usd REAL, model TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, completed_at INTEGER)
CREATE INDEX qa_model_usage_cell ON qa_model_usage(run_id,cell_id,state)
ALTER TABLE qa_seed_leases ADD COLUMN run_id TEXT
ALTER TABLE qa_seed_leases ADD COLUMN generation TEXT
CREATE INDEX qa_seed_run_lease ON qa_seed_leases(run_id,generation)

CREATE VIEW qa_active_seed_leases AS SELECT tenant,id,fingerprint,max_size,expires_at,run_id,generation FROM qa_seed_leases WHERE run_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT l.tenant,l.id,l.fingerprint,l.max_size,MIN(l.expires_at,q.deadline,r.deadline,j.lease_until) AS expires_at,l.run_id,l.generation FROM qa_seed_leases l JOIN qa_runs q ON q.id=l.run_id AND q.generation=l.generation JOIN reviews r ON r.id=q.review_id AND r.tenant=l.tenant JOIN jobs j ON j.id=q.job_id AND j.attempt=q.attempt WHERE q.state='running' AND r.cancelled=0 AND j.status='leased'

name: 0011_qa_evidence.sql
statements: ALTER TABLE qa_runs ADD COLUMN evidence_pruned INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0

CREATE TABLE qa_evidence (run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES qa_runs(id), id TEXT NOT NULL, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, review_id TEXT NOT NULL, generation TEXT NOT NULL, object_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, descriptor TEXT NOT NULL, bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('pending','stored')), expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(run_id,id))
CREATE INDEX qa_evidence_expiry ON qa_evidence(expires_at)
CREATE TABLE qa_evidence_manifests (run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES qa_runs(id), notes TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE qa_evidence_garbage (object_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenant TEXT NOT NULL, review_id TEXT NOT NULL, pending INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

name: 0012_qa_recommendations.sql
statements:
-- Advice has its own history: dismissing it never suppresses a defect.
CREATE TABLE qa_recommendation_history (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, repository TEXT NOT NULL, identity TEXT NOT NULL, first_review TEXT NOT NULL, first_seen_at INTEGER NOT NULL, last_review TEXT NOT NULL, last_seen_at INTEGER NOT NULL, candidate_json TEXT NOT NULL, dismissal_json TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(tenant,repository,identity))

CREATE TABLE qa_recommendation_sightings (tenant TEXT NOT NULL, repository TEXT NOT NULL, identity TEXT NOT NULL, review_id TEXT NOT NULL, seen_at INTEGER NOT NULL, candidate_json TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(tenant,repository,identity,review_id))

name: 0013_qa_retention.sql
statements:
-- Rotate retries so a stalled upload or transient deletion failure cannot
-- starve newer expired objects in the bounded scheduled sweep.
ALTER TABLE qa_evidence_garbage ADD COLUMN next_attempt_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
CREATE INDEX qa_evidence_garbage_retry ON qa_evidence_garbage(next_attempt_at,object_key)
